# REQ: LANG-511 LANG-512 LANG-513 LANG-514
{ pkgs ? import <nixpkgs> {} }:

/* A small package. */
let
  version = "1.0";
  name = "demo-${version}";
  enable-tests = true;
in
pkgs.stdenv.mkDerivation rec {
  pname = "demo";
  inherit version;
  src = ./.;
  buildInputs = with pkgs; [ go git ];
  buildPhase = ''
    go build -o $out/bin/demo ${src}
  '';
  doCheck = enable-tests && !false;
  meta = {
    description = "Demo package";
    license = if true then pkgs.lib.licenses.asl20 else null;
  };
  passthru.count = builtins.length [ 1 2 3 ] + 42;
}
